name: Unmatched supplier invoices -> invalid purchase risk
rationale: Without matching to receipt evidence, nothing stops invoices for goods never delivered from being recorded and paid. The rule directs vouching to GRNs, a test of the matching control, and follow-up of the exception population most at risk.
